report.title: {Items.Count} {Plural(Items.Count, 'group of devices receives', 'groups of devices receive')} conflicting Microsoft 365 Apps settings

messages.businessImpact: Devices receive different channels or architectures depending on order, which produces installation failures that are hard to reproduce.
remediation: Keep one Microsoft 365 Apps deployment per population, with channel and architecture set consistently.
messages.cannotSee: The two deployments are matched on the devices they reach, so an application assigned through a group whose members this run could not read is not judged. Only the servicing channel is compared: the rest of a Microsoft 365 Apps configuration, the applications included and the languages among them, is not read.
